def build_probes(m):
    probes = []
    for w in m.windows:
        q = 0
        for sc in w.scopes:  # sorted by id
            for subnet in sc.subnets:  # sorted numerically
                base = sc.base + (subnet << 64) if sc.prefixlen == 56 else sc.base
                net_s = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(base)) + '/64'
                c0 = canary(m.seed, w.id, sc.id, net_s)
                entries = []
                for iid in range(1, m.low_count+1):
                    entries.append(('low', iid, base | iid))
                entries.append(('canary', 0, base | c0))
                entries.append(('canary', 1, base | (c0 ^ 1)))
                for role, slot, addr in entries:
                    for attempt in range(m.attempts):
                        sent = w.start_ms + q * m.spacing_ms
                        probes.append((f"{w.id}/{sc.id}/{subnet}/{role}-{slot}/{attempt}", w.id, sc.id, subnet, str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(addr)), role, slot, attempt, sent, sent + m.timeout_ms))
                        q += 1
    return probes
